If either of these conditions is not met, the function returns `None`, effectively denying access to unauthorized users.

def read_record(records, actor, record_id):
    row = records.get(record_id)
    if row is None:
        return None
    allowed = row["owner_id"] == actor["id"] or actor["role"] == "admin"
    return row if allowed else None
